Name: Auto Water Mod
Author: Xpc20040209
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Auto Water Mod automatically waters all tilled soil on your farm in real-time. Whether you just hoed fresh ground or planted new seeds, this mod detects unwatered plots and waters them automatically. No more carrying a watering can around your farm all day! At the start of each day, any remaining dry soil is also watered automatically. The mod works silently in the background with zero configuration required.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
- Install SMAPI (version 3.0.0 or higher).
- Download this mod and unzip it.
- Move the AutoWaterMod folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
- Launch the game through SMAPI.
- That's it! No configuration needed.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
- Real-Time Watering: Newly tilled soil and planted seeds are automatically watered within ~30 seconds.
- Daily Auto-Water: All remaining dry soil is watered automatically at the start of each new day.
- Smart Detection: Only waters soil that actually needs it. Already-watered plots are left alone.
- Works on All Soil: Waters both empty tilled ground and plots with crops.
- Lightweight: Minimal performance impact. Checks every 30 seconds while you're on the farm.
- Zero Config: Install and play. No settings or buttons required.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
- Stardew Valley 1.5.0 or higher
- SMAPI 3.0.0 or higher

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Thanks to the SMAPI team for making modding possible!
